ImpactSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
ImpactSound.EmitterSize = 10
ImpactSound.Name = "ImpactSound"

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
 
s = Instance.new("Sky")
s.Name = "SKY"
s.SkyboxBk = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=118701329738738"
s.SkyboxDn = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=118701329738738"
s.SkyboxFt = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=118701329738738"
s.SkyboxLf = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=118701329738738"
s.SkyboxRt = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=118701329738738"
s.SkyboxUp = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=118701329738738"
s.Parent = game:GetService("Lighting")
 
Spooky = Instance.new("Sound", game:GetService("Workspace"))
Spooky.Name = "Spooky"
Spooky.SoundId = "rbxassetid://92844120383037"
Spooky.Volume = 10
Spooky.Looped = true
Spooky.Pitch = 1.2
Spooky:Play()
 
local noodlesTemplate = Workspace:WaitForChild("noodles")
 
-- аё‹а№€аё­аё™аё•а№‰аё™а№Ѓаёљаёља№„аё§а№‰
noodlesTemplate.Anchored = true
noodlesTemplate.Transparency = 1
noodlesTemplate.CanCollide = false
 
local dropCenter = Vector3.new(0, 300, 0)
 
while true do
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local noodle = noodlesTemplate:Clone()
        noodle.Parent = Workspace
        noodle.Anchored = false
        noodle.Transparency = 0
        noodle.CanCollide = true
        
        local offset = Vector3.new(
        math.random(-3, 3),
        0,
        math.random(-3, 3)
        )
        noodle.Position = dropCenter + offset
        
        noodle.Orientation = Vector3.new(
        math.random(0, 360),
        math.random(0, 360),
        math.random(0, 360)
        )
        
        local sound = noodle:FindFirstChild("ImpactSound")
        if sound then
            noodle.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if not sound.IsPlaying then
                    sound:Play()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    wait(5)
end  wait(5)
end
